summary: NICE Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a revised Compensation Policy for executive officers and directors, replacing a previously proposed policy. The revision reflects investor feedback received during ongoing communications. The company also postponed its Special General Meeting from June 2 to June 9, 2026, to allow shareholders more time to review the amended terms. The record date and meeting agenda remain unchanged. This filing is a routine corporate governance update involving a compensation policy change and meeting rescheduling, not a special situation event.
